title: Codex A路线候选反馈卡结构契约
description: 直接验证一张原始card对象，不验证bundle包装。兼容已审核卡中对象/数组包装和文本/数组差异。结构通过不等于语义或跨文件证据准入通过。
$comment: MANDATORY EXTERNAL ADMISSION: supporting_error_ids must resolve only to final admitted PASS observations with verified source/Gold and exact evidence; UNKNOWN/FAIL/excluded/pending revisions cannot be positive support. This cannot be proven by JSON Schema over ID strings alone. Bind and validate the independent review/adjudication registry before admitting a bundle. Draft only; not a modification of legacy runtime.

supporting_error_ids.description: Only external-registry admitted PASS error IDs; do not include unknown or excluded observations.

questioner_feedback.description: Empty is legitimate. Existing object wrappers and arrays are both retained; issue-specific semantic evidence is reviewed outside this card schema.

needed.description: In these cards this concerns confirmed source-shortfall repair, not whether a future authorized hypothesis-test extension is possible.

then.$comment: Every referenced shortage must externally resolve to independently CONFIRMED SOURCE_SHORTFALL on the bound source version. The schema cannot verify that review.

x-required-cross-document-checks: Every supporting error exists, belongs to a supporting candidate and the same Train root, has exact raw/source evidence, passes source and Gold review, and is finally admitted PASS.
UNKNOWN, FAIL, excluded, unresolved or superseded support is not admitted; pending REVISE cards require reviewed patches before bundle admission.
Final-answer, rationale and citation results are independent axes; preserve the correct-case denominator and do not inflate failed-question counts with reason-only observations.
Public projection uses REVIEW_CONTRACT.public_fields and removes original IDs, option labels, Gold, mappings, answer strings and raw responses from free text as well as keys.
Material author projection is constructed from neutral material goals, not copied from the full Challenger card; no solver errors, expected errors or Gold quotas.
Schema validity does not prove Challenger consumption, runtime integration, formal weakness reproduction or feedback/training benefit.
